description:
Cast Final Fortune for {R}{R}.
Move to your extra turn.
activate Feldon for {2}{R}Tap creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
With Archaeomancer's etb, put Final Fortune back into your hand.
Cast Final Fortune for {R}{R}.
Move to your end step, then activate Sundial of the Infinite to end your turn with Archaeomancer's sacrifice trigger and Final Fortune's lose the game trigger on the stack.
Repeat 2-6.
